explanation: His students compiled it after his death. It includes his version of the golden rule: do not impose on others what you would not choose for yourself.

claims.text: The Analects records the sayings and teachings of Confucius.
The Analects is not a record of the teachings of Laozi, Mencius or Mozi.
The Analects was compiled by Confucius's disciples and their followers after his death.
The Analects contains a version of the golden rule: do not impose on others what you do not wish for yourself.
